debrief db-021

3) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r b-l-a-m-e-d t-h-e s-e-i-z-u-r-e o-n a m-e-t-e-o-r-o-l-o-g-i-c-a-l s-t-o-r-m a-n-d l-e-f-t a f-a-k-e w-e-a-t-h-e-r a-l-e-r-t s-c-r-e-e-n-s-h-o-t i-n t-h-e i-n-c-i-d-e-n-t f-i-l-e w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g t-h-e c-r-o-s-s-r-e-f-e-r-e-n-c-e w-i-t-h o-f-f-i-c-i-a-l s-t-o-r-m d-a-t-a.
4) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r r-e-s-t-o-r-e-d t-h-e d-r-o-n-e n-e-t-w-o-r-k c-o-n-f-i-g a-f-t-e-r t-h-e w-i-n-d-o-w c-l-o-s-e-d a-n-d l-e-f-t t-r-a-c-i-n-g m-e-t-a-d-a-t-a i-n t-h-e o-p-e-r-a-t-o-r s-l-a-t-e w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g t-h-e i-m-m-e-d-i-a-t-e s-y-s-t-e-m r-e-s-c-a-n d-u-e d-i-l-i-g-e-n-c-e.
5) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r d-e-c-l-a-r-e-d t-h-e e-x-e-r-c-i-s-e a "t-e-c-h-n-i-c-a-l g-l-i-t-c-h" a-t t-h-e b-r-i-e-f-i-n-g a-n-d l-e-f-t a n-o-t-e e-m-a-i-l l-i-n-k-i-n-g t-o a t-h-i-r-d p-a-r-t-y f-o-r-u-m w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g t-h-e o-b-l-i-g-a-t-o-r-y c-o-n-f-l-i-c-t d-i-s-c-l-o-s-u-r-e s-t-e-p.
